stage1_4_approach_turn_kick.description: [ACTIVE] Stage 1.4 - approach + turn + kick (timesteps=200000). Robot now spawns away from the ball with random ±180° orientation; ball is random in the opponent half. `approach_ball` is enabled for the first time while `goto`/dribbles stay disabled. Must approach the ball, turn to face the goal, then kick. Carries Stage 1.2/1.3 kick safety: positive goal_progress and HER live progress are aim-gated, kick_requires_aim=true blocks bad kicks, kick_tie_break_when_aimed=true handles deterministic turn/kick ties, and approach_defer_when_has_ball=true prevents the newly unmasked approach slot from becoming a no-op after possession. Warm-start from stage1_3_full_turn_complete.zip.

_completed_substages._note: Finished sub-stages, archived with their full config for reference. The trainer ONLY runs blocks under 'curriculum', so nothing here re-runs. stage1_1_kick: completed run 20260602_132531 — 65% goal rate (see TRAINING.md §11); checkpoint models/20260602_132531_672811_td3_jal_her/stage1_1_kick_complete.zip. stage1_2_turn_warmup: completed run 20260602_180617 — deterministic infer 75.5% overall / 77.0% last-100, no bad-aim or invalid kicks; checkpoint models/20260602_180617_572684_td3_jal_her/stage1_2_turn_warmup_complete.zip. stage1_3_full_turn: completed run 20260602_184554 — deterministic infer 81.7% overall / 85.0% last-100, no bad-aim or invalid kicks; checkpoint models/20260602_184554_470708_td3_jal_her/stage1_3_full_turn_complete.zip.

stage1_1_kick.description: Stage 1.1 — learn to kick (timesteps=25000). Robot spawns AT the ball (0.5 behind, on the ball-goal axis) facing the goal with ±15° jitter; ball near the centre line (y∈[-3,3]). `turn` and `approach_ball` are DISABLED so the only selectable action is firing `kick` from the at-ball state. The ±15° spread (≈ the goal's angular width from x∈[5,30]) makes the kick robust to small aim error and seeds the critic with 'better alignment → more reward', which the turn stages build on. From scratch (top-level load_model=null).

stage1_2_turn_warmup.description: [COMPLETED] Stage 1.2 - turn warmup (timesteps=35000). Robot starts at the ball with goto/approach/dribbles disabled, and spawn_theta_relative_to_goal=true with |offset| in [25,55] deg makes immediate kicks miss. Fixes for the 20260602 kick-collapse and deterministic TD3 tie: positive goal_progress and HER live progress are aim-gated by projected goal-mouth quality; kick_requires_aim=true with kick_min_aim_quality=0.05 converts bad-aim kick requests into turn commands and charges invalid_action_penalty=0.5; kick_tie_break_when_aimed=true lets deterministic turn/kick logit ties execute kick only after aim is ready. Completed checkpoint: models/20260602_180617_572684_td3_jal_her/stage1_2_turn_warmup_complete.zip.

stage1_3_full_turn.description: [COMPLETED] Stage 1.3 - full turn (timesteps=150000). Robot starts at the ball with goto/approach/dribbles disabled; approach_ball stays locked until Stage 1.4. random_spawn_theta_range_deg=[-180,180] with spawn_theta_relative_to_goal=true makes the heading a full-circle offset from the ball->goal line. Uses the Stage 1.2 safety fixes: positive goal_progress and HER live progress are aim-gated, kick_requires_aim=true blocks bad kicks into turn commands with invalid_action_penalty=0.5, and kick_tie_break_when_aimed=true lets deterministic TD3 ties kick only after aim is ready. Completed checkpoint: models/20260602_184554_470708_td3_jal_her/stage1_3_full_turn_complete.zip.

_pending_substages._how_to_advance: Run one sub-stage at a time. After a stage finishes, inspect the run, make any tweaks, then advance: (1) move the next stage's block from here into 'curriculum', and move the FINISHED stage's block into '_completed_substages' (archived, not deleted — the trainer only runs 'curriculum'), (2) set top-level 'load_model' to the finished stage's checkpoint — note checkpoints land in a timestamped dir, e.g. models/<TIMESTAMP>_td3_jal_her/<stage>_complete.zip, (3) re-run the same launch command. num_robots stays 1 across all four, so TD3.load restores the expandable policy and the weights carry; the HER buffer is collected fresh each run.

stage2_mixed_opponent.description: Reference only (NOT in curriculum, so not run by the trainer). Example stage demonstrating a mixed opponent: scripted goalie + frozen policy for other robots. Move into 'curriculum' and provide opp_frozen_checkpoint.zip to activate.

_curriculum_note: Stage 1 is retrained from scratch on the expandable backbone (use_expandable_backbone=true) as four sub-stages, run ONE AT A TIME so progress can be inspected between stages. Only the stage(s) inside 'curriculum' run; completed stages are archived under '_completed_substages'. Order: 1.1 learn-to-kick (turn off, ±15°) → 1.2 turn warmup (±55° with minimum 25° miss) → 1.3 full ±180° turn at-ball with approach still disabled → 1.4 approach+turn+kick (spawn away, approach enabled). num_robots=1 throughout, so the expandable policy weights carry across sub-stages via load_model. The gradual 90→120 angle ramp was dropped — it learned worse than jumping ±60°→±180°. Reward configs are the authentic values recovered from the original td3_jal_her run logs, with Stage 1.2+ safety gates added for sim-embedded training.

model_params._action_noise_note: PER-DIM exploration sigma (added during collection only), tiled per robot over the 9-dim action: dims 0-5 = slot logits, 6-7 = goto_x/y, 8 = turn_theta (×π). action_noise_logit_std=0.4 keeps the turn/kick SLOTS sampled; action_noise_param_std=0.1 keeps turn_theta tight (±18°/step) so the robot can settle into clean alignment and the critic observes a well-aimed kick scoring +20/+150. action_noise_std is the fallback for any unset group. CRITICAL §17 BUG (now fixed in td3_jal_her_trainer.py): for warm-started runs TD3.load returned BEFORE the action-noise block ran, so the config sigma was IGNORED and the model reused the noise pickled into the loaded checkpoint. So §15's claimed σ=0.4 and §16's σ=0.2 NEVER took effect — both warm-started runs used stage 1.1's checkpoint noise, and their differing outcomes were seed variance, not the σ change. The deterministic eval of §15's checkpoint (infer_logs/20260602_162132) was turn=100%, 0 kicks, 0% goals — the greedy actor had collapsed to turn-forever. The trainer now re-attaches config noise after load (logs 'Applied config action noise to warm-started model' + the 'Per-dim action noise:' line). Tripwire: deterministic eval must show kicks > 0 and aim_quality rising. See §12-§17.
model_params._her_strategy_note: 'future' relabels stored transitions with diverse intermediate ball positions (essential for aim precision) rather than only the episode's terminal position. Requires the local patch to SB3 2.7.1 HerReplayBuffer._sample_goals that clamps the randint upper bound.
model_params._expandable_note: feature_dim/num_heads configure ExpandableJALFeatureExtractor (active because top-level use_expandable_backbone=true). include_goal feeds the HER desired_goal into the encoder's global branch so a later variable-target stage (e.g. passing) can fine-tune instead of needing an architecture change. Constant goal during stage 1, so harmless now.
